messages:
Omar Sheikh: hey team, first week here — running through the observability checklist and hit a weird one. The Grafana iframe embedded in the Incident Playbook shows "panel not found" but opening the dashboard directly works. embed url: https://grafana.redwood.example/d-solo/uvwx999/service-health?orgId=1&panelId=3. anyone know what causes this?
Priya (devex): welcome Omar! :wave: do you see any errors in the browser console (401/403/404) or a long "sig=..." param on the iframe? also are you on SSO + corporate VPN right now?
Omar Sheikh: console shows 401 on /render/d-solo and iframe url has sig param that looks expired. i'm on SSO but not on the VPN (remote today).
Diego (obs-eng): common cause is our signed embed tokens only valid from corp network or require a recent token rotation. We rolled a token last week and some playbook pages still have old signed URLs. If you're remote, VPN is usually required for embed renders.
Omar Sheikh: ok i'll try VPN. quick follow-up: who owns updating the playbook embed URLs when tokens rotate?
Priya (devex): DevEx maintains the playbooks but we rely on obs-eng to re-generate signed embeds after token rotations. i'll open a ticket and add you so you can track progress. @DevEx Bot can you create ticket?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3612 - "Playbook embeds: regenerate signed grafana embeds for Incident Playbook; add omar.sheikh@redwood.ai to ticket". Assignee: Priya. ETA: 1 business day.
Diego (obs-eng): temporary workaround: open the dashboard directly and use Share > Direct link to panel or Snapshot for runbook screenshots. If you need alerts or panel screenshots in the runbook right away, ping me and I can generate a fresh signed url.
Omar Sheikh: VPN + cleared cache — iframe still 401. Ticket noted. Two extra onboarding asks while we're here: 1) Datadog CLI returns "403 Forbidden" when I try `datadog app-key create --name omar-cli`; 2) Sentry shows only my personal sandbox org, not the company projects. who handles those perms?
Priya (devex): Datadog app-key creation can be restricted; infra may require approval or the `observability-cli` role. Sentry org/project access is managed by obs-eng. i'll add both asks to #DX-3612.
DevEx Bot: Updated #DX-3612: Added subtasks - "Create Datadog app key for omar.sheikh@redwood.ai" and "Add Omar to Sentry projects: frontend-api, service-ingest".
Diego (obs-eng): Omar, send me the repo names or project slugs you need and i'll add you to the Sentry teams. For Datadog, if `datadog app-key create` is forbidden we'll submit an infra request to create one or grant you the role.
Omar Sheikh: repos are github.com/redwood/frontend-api and github.com/redwood/service-ingest. Also, small question: how do I favorite dashboards so they appear in my Grafana Home? doesn't show until someone grants view perms?
Diego (obs-eng): Favoriting works once you have view access to the dashboard. If you can't favorite it, that means your account is missing the folder-level view permission. I'll check and add you to `redwood-observability-viewers` if needed.
Priya (devex): noted — adding that to #DX-3612 as well. Progress updates will be posted there. Omar, welcome again — ping here if anything else blocks your runbook walkthrough. :tada:
